newsitem.title: USA: Wells Fargo luring value players - report.
newsitem.headline: Wells Fargo luring value players - report.

text.p: Wells Fargo and Co shares are starting to lure buyers from value funds as investors strayed away from the company when it reported disappointing second quarter results, according to Business Week.

Janus Fund manager James Craig told Business Week that the stock could reach $350 to $360 a share as Wells integrates its purchase of First Interstate Bancorp, which was completed in April, and continues with stock repurchases.

Institutional investors had frowned upon Wells Fargo, which closed at $261, after the second quarter when the bank said the $800 million in savings it expected from the merger would take longer than expected, the magazine reported.
Craig, whose fund holds $12 billion in assets, told the magazine that he has been buying the stock during the recent price weakness in a market with few bargains.
